title: Slider

fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: Human interface device that emits a controllable signal

body:
"Outputs a signal from [0.0, 10.0], depending on slider position."

The Slider is a logic component that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics. It outputs a continuous signal that can be adjusted.

Functionality

When placed, the Slider initally starts in its zero position, which is the furthest point away from the output port. The user can interact with the Slider to increase or decrease the value; higher values move the lever closer to the output port. The Slider can output any signal level between 0 and 10 in steps of 1. The Slider inherits the color of the wire that is attached to its output port.

Trivia

  • This item was previously called the "SliderComponent".
